translated_text: The Tao that can be told is not the eternal Tao.
The name that can be named is not the eternal name.

original_text: 無名天地之始；有名萬物之母。
translated_text: The nameless is the beginning of heaven and earth. The named is the mother of ten thousand things.

original_text: 故常無，欲以觀其妙；常有，欲以觀其徼。
translated_text: Ever desireless, one can see the mystery. Ever desiring, one can see the manifestations.

original_text: 此兩者，同出而異名，同謂之玄。玄之又玄，眾妙之門。
translated_text: These two spring from the same source but differ in name; this appears as darkness. Darkness within darkness. The gate to all mystery.
